### Gezel adaptations

The source skill's detailed per-section rubric (sections/review-sections.md) is not bundled. Produce a scored review anyway: for each pass give a 0-10 score plus one line on what would make it a 10, and end with a mode verdict — SCOPE EXPANSION, SELECTIVE, HOLD, or SCOPE REDUCTION — with the two or three decisive reasons. For a second opinion, consult another gezel with `ask_specialist` instead of an external model CLI.
